_comment: Functions intentionally excluded from the 100%-of-bindable denominator. Every name here MUST exist in docs/api-inventory.json (the checker typo-guards them). See docs/binding-coverage.md.

internal_preinit.rationale: Non-public implementation details of an init path; the public init functions are bound instead. ma_encoder_init__internal and ma_encoder_preinit are the encoder's pre-init steps. ma_sound_init_from_file_internal is exported but has no public prototype: it is the file branch of ma_sound_init_ex and relies on state that ma_sound_init_ex has already set up through the static ma_sound_preinit (the ma_sound zeroed and its seek target primed, the end callback copied), so calling it directly leaves the sound half-initialised. ma_sound_init_ex (bound, via SoundConfig.set_file_path) and ma_sound_init_from_file (bound) reach it through the supported path.

wchar_w_variants.rationale: Windows wide-char (const wchar_t*) path APIs. Project is linux-64 only (pixi.toml); the UTF-8 *_file / *_vfs / *_memory siblings cover the need.

deprecated_assert_false.rationale: Deprecated miniaudio functions that assert(false) at runtime and are scheduled for removal. Not safe to call.

custom_callback_or_vtable_ctor.rationale: Take user-supplied function pointers (custom I/O for decoder/encoder/wav/flac/mp3, the sound end callback). Excluded originally because the 2026-05 Mojo nightly could not pass a function value across the FFI. That is no longer true: on Mojo 1.1.0 a probe (2026-10-08) passed generic trampolines to C, stored them and called them later from C threads, and ma_decoder_init driven by a Mojo stream decoded bit-identically to ma_decoder_init_file. They are bindable and kept here only until the binding lands (roadmap step 18 in docs/binding-coverage.md; paused work on local branches wip/stream-callback-ctors and wip/sound-end-callback), so the families' complete flags stay true.

deprecated_superseded.rationale: Deprecated aliases documented for removal in miniaudio 0.12; the canonical replacements are bound instead. ma_engine_get_time/set_time forward to ma_engine_get_time_in_pcm_frames/set_time_in_pcm_frames (both bound).

custom_backend_authoring.rationale: Only meaningful when implementing a custom ma_backend. ma_device_post_init is a step *within* backend device-init: it takes an ma_device_descriptor the backend negotiates (there is no valid descriptor to fabricate from pure Mojo) and miniaudio documents it as 'You do not need to call this manually unless you are doing a custom backend' and 'Unsafe' (it reinitializes internal data converters that may be in use). The two callers are inside miniaudio's own ma_device_init. Authoring a custom backend (a vtable of ~20 callbacks) is out of scope for these bindings; the standard ma_device_init / ma_device_init_ex paths ARE bound.

win32_only_not_exported.rationale: Defined only under MA_WIN32 (WCHAR is a Win32 type), so the linux-64 build exports no such symbol: `nm -D --defined-only build/libma_shim.so` has none of them. There is nothing to bind on this platform. The portable wchar_t helpers (ma_wcslen, ma_wcscmp, ma_wcscpy_s) are bound instead.
